gate: Eq.(1)-(2) fee-rate audit (reproduced, full tape, scripted)
scope: v2 tape, taker-paid fills (is_taker_order=TRUE, deduped, v2_a/v2_b, OrderFilled)
method: ratio=(fee_raw/1e6)/(price*(1-price)*shares) (median confirms r=7%); incidence=(fee_raw/1e6)/usdc=r(1-p) (the 7% ceiling); approx_quantile for medians; frac_over = share above threshold. The ratio's upper tail is a per-order-aggregate artifact (concavity of p(1-p)); the incidence ceiling is the real bound.
